title: Beiersdorf AG proposed acquisition of the Leuko brand from BSN medical

body_sections.Summary: Beiersdorf AG proposed acquisition of the Leuko brand from BSN medical
body_sections.Market definition: The Australian market for the supply to resellers of rigid strapping tape and elastic adhesive bandage
body_sections.Competition analysis: Elastoplast owned 50% of the Leuko Brand. The ACCC found that in moving to 100% ownership it was not clear that this would lead to a substantial lessening of competition.
